content.title: The export of large accounts runs into the API's time limit: how should we deal with it before the next version ships?
content.body:
For large accounts the export takes up to **45 seconds**; the API's limit is 30. So far it simply stops, and the user sees an empty file.

I measured three ways. Each has a catch: more time holds connections, an asynchronous export needs a notification, and trimming the data changes what the export contains.

This text is too long for a card on purpose (more than 300 characters and more than five lines), to show how the Desk and the card's page deal with it: cut it, wrap it, show "more".

options.label: Raise the time limit to sixty seconds
options.detail: Holds connections longer, no other code change needed

options.label: Export in the background, with a notification
options.detail: About two days of rework, but no limit at all

options.label: Export only the last twelve months
options.detail: Fast, but older data is missing from the export

options.label: Decide after the release
options.detail: Until then the export fails for large accounts

content.title: The hub's new start: code and measurements
content.body:
This is what the hub's new start looks like. Just to read, nothing to decide.

```js
const turbo = turboRoutes({ state: () => state, commit, decide })
httpServer.listen(PORT, HOST, () => console.log(`[board] on ${PORT}`))
```

| Page | Requests | kB | first paint |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| Desk old | 81 | 1311 | 144 ms |
| Desk Turbo | 32 | 1039 | 84 ms |
| Card Turbo | 22 | 375 | 60 ms |

And a list:
- `server/turbo.mjs`: routes and stream
- `server/views/*.mjs`: templates
- __important__: no build step
